description: Masse en tonnes et taux de valorisation des déchets en propre (dangereux et non dangereux) par opérateur is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente la masse et le taux de valorisation des déchets par opérateur depuis 2016, en distinguant les déchets dangereux des déchets non dangereux. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Déchet, RSE. The portal shows 2021-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
